column2: naive RAG (Tutorial 7): get_text + recursive splitter + BM25 top-5 over the whole corpus, no parsing, never returns []
+ table_to_text: tables enter the index with their row labels and column headers instead of a run of loose numbers
+ structured chunks: one section per chunk, tables kept whole with the caption and header repeated, a context line on top
+ tokenizer: lower case, punctuation split, stop words dropped, numbers keep their decimal point
+ parse_query: search only the company the question names, and only the document type it asks for (the year must match exactly)
+ year window {Y, Y+1} for annual reports and {Y-1, Y} for calls and reports, instead of the exact year
+ per-company retrieval: a comparison alternates between the companies it names instead of returning five chunks of one
+ abstention: [] when the corpus has no such company, no such year, or never mentions the metric
+ tie-breakers on top of BM25: the question's year in the text, and how much of the question the chunk covers (= the submitted retrieve)
